name: agent-kb
description: Turn your coding-agent sessions into a local, searchable knowledge base.

summarizer.title: Summaries
summarizer.description: off = index only, no model call. claude = your claude CLI summarizes. api = the Anthropic API with the key below. Redacted transcript text goes to that provider.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Comma list of claude-code, claude-desktop-code, claude-cowork. Empty = all.

vault_dir.title: Obsidian vault directory
vault_dir.description: Optional. Notes are written under <vault>/<folder>/. Empty = no notes.

vault_folder.title: Vault folder
vault_folder.description: Folder inside the vault for agent-kb's notes.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Only for summaries = api. Stored in your OS credential store.
